target_customer: Small and mid-size manufacturers and job shops that receive purchase orders by scan, email or fax
problem: Factory staff manually key purchase orders into the ERP. Smartbase extracts the data with AI and routes it through a review dashboard before posting to the ERP.
business_model: B2B SaaS for manufacturers (pricing not stated)
product_category: AI purchase order entry and ERP automation

founders.name: Sam Goldman
previous_startups: Seed-stage DevOps platform (CEO; launch post says it raised $2M)
founders.background_notes: Source: YC page and launch post. Platform is not named.

founders.name: Taira Fujioka
founders.background_notes: YC page: built inference infrastructure for enterprises including Salesforce and JP Morgan.

competitors.name: Didero
competitors.what: Agentic AI that automates manufacturing procurement workflows

technical_complexity.rationale: Extracting structured data from messy scans and faxes and integrating with many ERPs is standard LLM engineering with hard integration work.

defensibility.rationale: ERP integrations create some lock-in, but several vendors and funded startups offered order-entry automation.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent action against Smartbase was found.

market_need_then: Manual order entry into ERPs is a long-standing cost for manufacturers, and AI order-entry startups raised seed rounds in 2025 and 2026.

branding.domain_note: Uses smartbase.so, not a .com; acquisition history not found.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found

brand_strength.rationale: Generic compound name, a .so domain and no press about the brand. A branding search returned nothing about the brand.

outcome_analysis: Smartbase automated PO entry for manufacturers and the YC directory lists it as inactive. The company site returned HTTP 503 so the product state could not be checked, and no shutdown, acquisition or funding news was found, so the cause of the inactive status is not public.
notes: Funding: two searches found no round. Batch is Spring 2026 per the queue; the YC page text in one search summary said Summer 2025 and another directory said P26, so the batch is conflicting. Website fetch returned HTTP 503. Other rivals seen (Comena, Endeavor, Conexiom, Arzana) had undated sources and are not listed.
